summary.name: Is It Private?
summary.one_liner: A Safari extension for macOS that changes its toolbar icon's appearance when Private Browsing is enabled, making it easier to tell private from normal windows in Dark mode.
use_cases: Seeing at a glance whether the current Safari window is private
Distinguishing private and normal browsing under macOS Dark mode
Installing a Safari toolbar indicator from the Mac App Store
Building a Safari extension from source for review
summary.what_it_does: Is It Private is a Safari App Extension that adds a toolbar icon. The icon changes its visual appearance when Private Browsing is enabled in Safari, which the page says is especially helpful when macOS Dark appearance is active. The page says it can be installed from the Mac App Store, by downloading the latest release from its GitHub repository, or by building it from source. The page includes a privacy policy stating that the extension does not store or transmit personal details and includes no advertising, tracking, or analytics software that talks to third parties. The project is open source.
notable: Toolbar icon visually changes when Safari Private Browsing is on
Open source, with source on GitHub
Privacy policy: no personal data stored or transmitted, no third-party tracking or analytics
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Only works with Safari on macOS, as a Safari App Extension
